text: Fill in the correct microbiology term in each sentence.
questions: Unlike disinfection, *sterilisation:This process leaves no viable organisms at all — not even spores.* eliminates all forms of microbial life including bacterial endospores.
Chemical agents used on inanimate surfaces to eliminate most pathogens are performing *disinfection:This applies to surfaces and objects, not living tissue.*.
Applying povidone-iodine to a patient's skin before surgery is an example of *antisepsis:This is the application of antimicrobial agents specifically to living tissue.*.
Before instruments enter the autoclave, *decontamination:This initial step reduces microbial load to a safe handling level.* must be performed to remove gross organic matter.
